subject.statement: René Benko was convicted in 2025 and his wife Nathalie was convicted alongside him.
disambiguators: his wife Nathalie was convicted alongside him

summary: As of late 2024 and early 2025, René Benko was under investigation for fraud related to the Signa Group's collapse, but no court had rendered a conviction against him or his wife Nathalie Benko by 2025. No credible reports indicate a joint conviction in that year.
